results.releaseNotes:
Minor update:

- Lysoniq on macOS is now Lysoniq Mac Remote - a clearer name for what it does: browse and control Apple Music, with playback handled by the Music app.
- Classical tracks now show the composer in Now Playing, the queue and the minibar.
Bug fixes:
- The Mac window resizes again.
- Smart playlists available on the Mac again.
- Plays through the Music app via Lysoniq Mac Remote now update play counts correctly. 
- Fixed sidebar stalling issue on macOS 27 beta builds.

The Audio Quality (beta) overlay has temporarily been moved to TestFlight only as refinement on this feature continues.
results.description:
Lysoniq is a premium music player/streamer with cross-device remote control. Install it on your Apple devices to seamlessly play music through any one of them and control the app with the others.

Unlike AirPlay, the playing device streams directly from Apple Music at full resolution — enabling Hi-Res Lossless with zero compression or downsampling on compatible devices. Using an iPhone, iPad, Mac or Apple TV in your hifi system just became easier. No more extension cables or compromises.

Built to handle huge libraries — load thousands of songs into the player without slowdown. Full queue management with swipe to delete, drag to rearrange, tap to skip ahead, and insert into the queue. True Shuffle that actually randomizes your music. 

Browse the full Apple Music catalog with top songs, albums, and playlists across 30+ cities and countries, 17 genres, and dedicated Hi-Res Lossless and Dolby Atmos sections. Access Made For You, Recently Played, New Releases, live radio stations, and all of Apple Music's personalized recommendations. Your full synced library with sorting and filtering included.

Connect and control devices across your home Wi-Fi network with LYNQ. Extend connectivity across cellular data and different Wi-Fi networks with the LYNQ+ subscription.

Built-in Last.fm scrobbling with full history and stats. Four themes including Light, Dark, True Light, and True Dark.

Built from the ground up with audiophiles in mind. Reviewing audio gear? Use a subloop to focus in on a particular section of a track, with the option to add a timer between loops to switch equipment. Output up to 24-bit/192kHz on iOS, 24-bit/192kHz on macOS (played via Music.app), and 24-bit/48kHz on Apple TV (24-bit/192kHz available on tvOS 27 with latest generation hardware).

Now available in 22 languages including Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified, and Traditional), Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Hebrew, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian Bokmål, Polish, Portuguese (Portugal), Russian, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, and Turkish.

Provide feedback to guide its development further and get the features you want. Enjoy all future updates with a one-time purchase.

Requires Apple Music installed on your devices and an active Apple Music subscription. See https://www.lysoniq.app/support for more details.

Terms of Use: https://www.lysoniq.app/terms
License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Compatibility includes iOS 16.4+, macOS 14.6+, tvOS 17.6+

results.releaseNotes:
New in this update:

- Crossfade (iOS 18+): smoothly blend the end of one song into the start of the next. Turn it on and set the length (1 - 12 seconds) in Settings under Song Transitions.
- Album "About" notes: Apple Music's editorial write-ups now appear on album pages. Tap "More" to read the full notes. (iOS, macOS, and tvOS.)

Library updates:
- Updated toolbar menu on Songs, Albums, Artists, Recently Added, and Playlists with quick Play, Shuffle, Search, and Refresh. 
- Play or Shuffle a whole library view in one tap (up to 10,000 songs). Use filtering to reduce to your desired content.
- Search now lives in the menu to show more content when not needed - tap Search to show it.
